\section*{Scripture typography}

Serif scripture with a different sans serif body font. The heading, chapter
drop cap and first verse must stay together.
\begin{multicols}{2}
\begin{scripture}[Genesis 1:1--5][version=KJV,book=Genesis]
\ExplSyntaxOn
\bool_if:NF \l__scripture_chap_drop_bool {\errmessage{Drop chapters not enabled}}
\bool_if:NT \l__scripture_chap_para_bool {\errmessage{Paragraph chapters still enabled}}
\ExplSyntaxOff

\ifnum\tolerance=400\else\errmessage{Scripture tolerance not applied}\fi
\heading{The Beginning}
\ch{1}
\vs{1}In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
\vs{2}And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the
face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

\vs{3}And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
\vs{4}And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light
from the darkness.
\vs{5}And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night.
And the evening and the morning were the first day.
\end{scripture}
\end{multicols}

\section*{Poetry and divine names}
\begin{scripture}[Psalm 23:1--3][version=KJV]
\heading{A Psalm of David}
\begin{poetry}
\ch{23}
\vs{1}The \name{Lord} is my shepherd;\\
I shall not want.\\
\vs{2}He maketh me to lie down in green pastures:\\
he leadeth me beside the still waters.\\
\vs{3}He restoreth my soul:\\
he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness\\
for his name's sake.
\end{poetry}
\end{scripture}
